title: Senate Armed Services Committee (SASC) on Emerging Threats and Capabilities Briefing 2023
doc_notes: This is a stenographic transcript of a 2023 Senate Armed Services Committee hearing regarding the All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO), which contains summaries of specific UAP cases and general discussion of UAP reporting.

encounters.summary: An MQ-9 drone in the Middle East captured footage of an apparent spherical object that appeared to pop in and out of the field of view.
encounters.quote: an apparent spherical object, via EO sensors

encounters.summary: An MQ-9 drone in South Asia captured footage of an object that initially appeared anomalous with a trail, but was later identified as a commuter aircraft.
encounters.quote: it actually turns out to be an aircraft
